en.topic_title: Hong Kong public housing provider fined HK$8,000 over faulty fire alarm following fatal Kwun Tong blaze
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s second-largest public housing provider has been fined HK$8,000 for failing to keep fire alarms functional at an estate where a blaze killed a man last October.



Kwun Tong Garden Estate. Photo: Hong Kong Housing Society.



The Hong Kong Housing Society (HKHS) pleaded guilty on Friday to one count of “failing to keep fire service installation in efficient working order” at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Court following the fatal blaze at Lotus Tower, Kwun Tong Garden Estate, on October 30 l
